name: Cheesy Taco Smash Burger over Napa Cabbage, Carrot & Bell Pepper Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
3 medium carrots
3 green bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a large bowl.
Peel and trim carrots; using a peeler, peel the carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Place beef, tomato paste, and spices in another large bowl. Use your hands to combine the beef mixture. Form into 6 equal-sized meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs to the skillet, spacing them apart; press down with the bottom of a spatula to form ½-inch thick patties. Cook, undisturbed, until golden on one side, about 3 minutes.

When the burgers are done on one side, flip and top with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and burgers are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Transfer burgers to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the burgers are cooking, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender-crisp, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. When the veggies are done, add cilantro to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide vegetable sauté between plates or bowls, then top with cheesy burgers and yogurt. Enjoy!
